## The finding

::: {#cell-fig-hero .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
rng = np.random.default_rng(11)
t = np.arange(60)
actual = 100 + 15*np.sin(t/6) + rng.normal(0, 4, 60)
fc = 100 + 15*np.sin(t/6)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4.2))
ax.fill_between(t, fc-8, fc+8, color="#2563eb", alpha=0.12, label="80% interval")
ax.plot(t, actual, color="#8a909a", lw=1.6, label="actual")
ax.plot(t, fc, color="#2563eb", lw=2.4, label="forecast")
ax.legend(frameon=False); ax.set_xlabel("week"); ax.set_ylabel("units")
for s in ["top","right"]: ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)
ax.grid(axis="y", color="#eef0f4", lw=1); plt.tight_layout()
fig.savefig("hero.png", dpi=120, bbox_inches="tight", facecolor="white"); plt.show()
```
